name: Low Self Esteem 2
overview: Scripture reveals that our true worth is rooted in being created in God's own image, affirming inherent dignity beyond worldly judgment (Genesis 1:27). Our self-perception is shaped by the thoughts of our hearts, highlighting the importance of aligning our minds with God's truth rather than fleeting emotions (Proverbs 23:7). Jesus invites those burdened and weary to find rest in Him, offering comfort and restoration to those struggling with low self-esteem (Matthew 11:28). Furthermore, Christ's outreach to sinners demonstrates His grace toward the broken, encouraging us to embrace our identity in Him rather than the world's rejection (Luke 15:1).
